title: Business Pipeline Snapshot
instructions: Produce a board-ready visual with pipeline health, segment concentration, and likely quarter risk.

analysis.headline: Enterprise owns the pipeline, but partner deals convert most efficiently
analysis.narrative: Enterprise contributes the largest absolute weighted forecast, while Partner shows the best win rate. SMB has the lowest win rate and smallest weighted contribution.

insights.label: Enterprise concentration
insights.explanation: Enterprise is 50% of raw pipeline and 50% of weighted forecast.

insights.label: SMB drag
insights.explanation: SMB has the fastest cycle but only a 35% win rate.

recommended_visuals.title: Pipeline vs weighted forecast by segment
recommended_visuals.purpose: Compare raw and probability-adjusted opportunity value.

analysis.layout_guidance: Use two strong visuals with metric callouts: horizontal bar comparison on the left, efficiency scatter on the right.
